cases.expect_why: unanimous-ambiguous library clause: neither party drafted it, so VOID with a refund
cases.name: library_clause_unanimous_voids

cases.expect_why: maker-authored custom wording found genuinely ambiguous by a unanimous panel: read against the maker (contra proferentem, Restatement S206) -- maker took the YES side, so the adverse reading is NO
cases.name: custom_wording_maker_yes_reads_no

cases.expect_why: maker-authored custom wording found genuinely ambiguous by a unanimous panel: read against the maker (contra proferentem, Restatement S206) -- maker took the NO side, so the adverse reading is YES
cases.name: custom_wording_maker_no_reads_yes

cases.expect_why: panel is not unanimous that the wording is genuinely ambiguous; not applicable
cases.name: not_unanimous_returns_none

cases.expect_why: patent-ambiguity limit: the compiler flagged this term at review and the non-drafter accepted it anyway, so contra proferentem is waived; falls back to ordinary burden of proof
cases.name: patent_ambiguity_limit_returns_none
